notes.title: Dead Man's Draw v1.01 Released
notes.content:
The first patch for Dead Man's Draw makes improvements to the AI and user interface, plus rebalances the Casanova trait to avoid some combos we felt were a little too good. A few bugs have also been squashed.

See below for the full list of patch notes:

[b]Gameplay & UI Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Re-balanced Casanova trait. It now auto-banks the card you choose to replay, instead of the Mermaid. This makes for a more interesting trait and eliminates some trait combo exploits.
[*] Improved mouse input to make accidental discards & unregistered clicks less likely.
[*] Misc AI improvements.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fix for crash related to the Parry trait.
[*] Potential fix for startup crashes related to save data.
[*] Fix for infinite sound effect looping during XP and score awards.
[*] Fixed visual issue of cards being stacked improperly in the river after some types of Mermaid combos.
[*] Fix for Trait Info Screen input issues.
[/list]
Thanks as always for your support and your feedback.
